_comment: Slag Rubble: the burnt fraction that never fused into the fill. The mineral half of the
depths, against techno-organic waste's salvage half - the same split Stone Rubble and the
Block of Garbage make in the overworld.
FIRST PASS, weights for the balance pass (#36). Slag itself leads because this is where the
word came from: the Cupola rakes it a lump at a time, and a whole dimension of it is what
makes the Slag Furnace worth owning.
